Extracts article:published_time, modified_time, author, section, and tags

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { WasmCrawlConfig, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg-wasm";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = WasmCrawlConfig.default();
  engineConfig.ssrf.denyPrivate = false;
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
  console.log(result.metadata.article.publishedTime);
  console.log(result.metadata.article.modifiedTime);
  console.log(result.metadata.article.author);
  console.log(result.metadata.article.section);
  console.log(result.metadata.article.tags.length);
}

void main();
```
